set.body: Evidence: FoldPipelineFit requires OperatorProgram plus OperatorFitBundle and therefore admits the spectral branch only; MathematicalModelEvidenceIr has no constructor from runtime fits and tests hand-author program, trace and certificate identities. Acceptance: define the smallest model-family-neutral fitted artifact contract; adapt the existing spectral fit and executable GLRM fit; support fold-safe ModelSpec execution and runtime-to-evidence lowering for both; reject foreign or synthetic identity combinations; round-trip evidence on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Unify fitted-model lifecycle and runtime evidence emission
